cards.card: Secured credit card with a term deposit

note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): Khan Bank, Golomt Bank and the Trade and Development Bank; only the Trade and Development Bank's pages, already found, were read this time, for want of the research's budget. The Trade and Development Bank of Mongolia's four credit card pages, read on 2026-10-30 (the Gold first read 2026-10-29): the Gold and Lady cards cost 19,900 tugriks a year, charge 2% a month on purchases and 3% on cash, give up to 45 days free of interest and ask a minimum payment of 10%; the Platinum costs 299,900 a year, at the same rates, with up to 50 days free and a 10% minimum; the card secured against a term deposit costs 19,900 a year, charges 1.83% a month on purchases in tugriks, gives no interest-free period and asks a 10% minimum (a condition, the pledged deposit, the game doesn't check). Each charges an over-limit fee and a past-due fee of 1%, at least 10,000 tugriks; the pages don't name what the 1% is of, so neither is written. The cards' dollar terms aren't written.
